name: Giza necropolis
frame: East-north-up at the Great Pyramid's base centre; +Z up, so subterranean features have negative Z.
note: Origin coordinates are the commonly cited base centre; replace with the Dash/GPMP-tied values. Elevation is approximate.

name: Cydonia Mensae
frame: East-north-up at the 'Face' mesa. Placeholder: coordinates from memory and unverified; no structures entered.
note: Registered only so the model never assumes Earth or Giza. Imagery: Viking 1 frame 035A72 (1976), MGS MOC (2001), HiRISE (2007 onward, with DTMs). A Martian sky needs its own precession model; packages/sky is Earth-only.

name: Hawara
frame: East-north-up at the base centre of Amenemhat III's pyramid; +Z up. No source checked gives the pyramid's azimuth, so its sides are taken as cardinal.
note: Placeholder origin: the latitude and longitude are read off Elshazly et al. 2024, Fig. 1 (scaled, unverified), and the elevation is their 'about 32 m' above sea level for the pyramid's base (p. 40). The Labyrinth's remains lie south of the pyramid. Chapter 8 lays them over Giza for scale (night decision 26), and the distance in that label is computed from the two origins, not typed.
